source_notes: Unique UPI users (NPCI's count of distinct customers onboarded, cumulative; not monthly active users), from official documents only, read on 09-10-2026. NPCI publishes no monthly user count: its monthly statistics give banks live, volume and value only, and no RBI Payment System Report or Annual Report from 2019-20 to 2025-26 gives one. The sources name the measure three ways ('unique customers in UPI', 'unique UPI users', 'users onboarded on UPI platform'); all read as the same cumulative count. Points marked approximate say 'individuals' or 'serves' with no stated as-of date. Left out: 'over 30 crore individuals' (PIB, 30-10-2023), a round floor, though consistent with the points either side; '46.52 crore users as on 01-02-2025' (PIB PRID 2098487), which is DigiLocker, not UPI. The story interpolates between points month by month and says so; nothing here refers to November 2019 itself.
